degrees: M.Sc. Student in Biochemistry at University of Lagos (UNILAG)

historical_milestones_and_metrics.details: Designed and executed an interdisciplinary study and learning initiative for over 800 students during undergraduate studies.
Served as Secretary and Public Relations Officer for the Education CDS group in Osun State (Jan–Jun 2025). Experienced strategy and control room operations.
Executed strategic outreach and community awareness campaigns that drove verified user growth.
Co-founded Academdum, a structured learning ecosystem designed to unlock student creative potential.
Established a 12-week AI literacy framework for younger generations (February 2026).

beyond_pathways.mission: Redefining Biochemistry, translating scientific training into real-world value, economic impact, and career pathways.
key_editions: July 2026: Redefining Biochemistry feat. Dr. Omowumi T. Kayode (MTU / Max Planck Centre Director)
July 2026: Redefining Biochemistry feat. Inioluwa Onabowale (FrieslandCampina)

rat_kingdom.timeline: Started September 2025 with 3 male and 3 female Wistar rats.
rat_kingdom.growth: Grew to 30+ within 4 months, faced losses (~1/4 died by April 2026), expanded to 60+ in major housing with parents' support.
rat_kingdom.purpose: A research model environment for biochemists and creatives to conduct experimental research in Lagos.
